description: React component for a context menu (FlowListMenu) that provides options to manage chatflows or agents, including rename, duplicate, export, delete, and configuration dialogs.

methods.name: refreshFlows
methods.description: Refreshes the list of flows based on current page and limit, with different API requests depending on agent or flow type.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Opens the options menu by setting the anchor element.

methods.name: handleFlowRename
methods.description: Opens the dialog to rename the flow.

methods.name: handleFlowStarterPrompts
methods.description: Opens the dialog for starter prompts configuration.

methods.name: handleExportTemplate
methods.description: Opens the dialog to save the flow as a template.

methods.name: handleAllowedDomains
methods.description: Opens the allowed domains configuration dialog.

methods.name: saveFlowRename
methods.description: Saves the new name for the flow and refreshes the flow list.

methods.name: saveFlowCategory
methods.description: Saves the selected categories for the flow.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the flow, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: handleDuplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the flow by storing its data and opening the relevant canvas URL.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Exports the flow data as a JSON file.
